notes.title: Ventilate - Steampunk Bullet Hell - Out Now
notes.content:
[h1][/h1][previewyoutube="C9nWqd1TocI;full"][/previewyoutube][h1][b]Ventilate – Steampunk Bullet Hell[/b][/h1][p]The Steampunk Game From Ink-Fox Studios. A single-player bullet-hell game in a steampunk world where constructs have gone rogue. Use steam to fuel your weapons. Find your family and escape the collapsing city.[/p][p][b]Welcome to Hell[/b]
Set in a richly detailed steampunk world, Ventilate combines gritty industrial visuals with fast-paced, chaotic gameplay. The world is filled with rogue constructs—machines that have turned against their creators—creating a tense and immersive atmosphere.[/p][p][b]Unique Steam-Powered Mechanics[/b]
Instead of traditional ammo, all weapons and gadgets are powered by steam pressure. Players must strategically recharge at vents scattered throughout the map, adding a layer of tactical depth to the action.[/p][p][b]Intense, High-Octane Combat[/b]
You play as Rosalyn, a construction worker turned survivor, navigating a collapsing city while dodging waves of bullets and battling massive bosses—like a monstrous steam train that barrels through the battlefield.[/p][p][b]Narrative-Driven Progression[/b]
The story is personal and urgent: Rosalyn is trying to find her family and escape the city. As you progress, you uncover the mystery behind the rogue constructs, which adds emotional weight and intrigue to the gameplay.[/p][p][b]Award Recognition[/b]
It was nominated for Best Upcoming Game at the IMIRT Irish Game Awards in 2025, highlighting its innovation and quality within the indie game scene.[/p]

notes.title: Ventilate 9th Of May
notes.content:
Ventilate: The Bullet Hell Gauntlet Arrives May 9th

Get ready to dodge, dash, and dominate in Ventilate, the relentless new bullet hell game launching on May 9th. In this high-octane challenge, you play as Rosalyn, a fierce survivor trapped in a mechanical nightmare. Her mission? Survive wave after wave of murderous machines and towering bosses, all designed to end her journey in a blaze of bullets.

But Rosalyn isn’t going down without a fight. Armed with steam-powered weaponry, she must stay on the move—shoot, run, reload—and tap into strategically placed steam pipes to recharge her arsenal. Every level is a test of reflexes and resolve, with enemies that never let up and environments that push you to the edge.

One of the standout bosses? A monstrous steam train that barrels through the battlefield, spewing death and destruction. Can Rosalyn outmaneuver it and bring it down?

Ventilate isn’t just hard—it’s brutal. But for those who crave the thrill of impossible odds and pixel-perfect precision, this is your next obsession.

Can Rosalyn survive? Only the fastest will find out.

MAY the 9th - Release Day
